text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but I should judge each sale by the stock’s prospects and my overall plan, not just by locking in a profit.","Selling winners while leaving the rest untouched can change my portfolio balance; I should review all positions together before deciding.","I rarely trade, and that can help me avoid impulsive decisions, but I should still check periodically that my holdings and cash fit my goals."]}
